topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and sets the scope for the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms by which the innate immune system senses pathogens and cellular damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory response propagation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells initiate local and systemic inflammatory cascades to recruit circulating leukocytes and coordinate immune responses.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the mechanisms responsible for shutting down inflammation and repairing damaged tissues, as well as the persistence of chronic inflammation and granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing remarks and previews the topic of the following lecture.
